name: When should I consider replacing my gas water heater instead of repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my gas water heater instead of repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your gas water heater rather than repairing it if the unit is over 10-12 years old, requires frequent or very costly repairs, or if it's operating inefficiently. For example, if the cost of a single repair approaches half the price of a new unit, or if significant leaks indicate tank failure, replacement is often the more economical long-term solution. CG Plumbing Solutions can help you weigh the pros and cons of repair versus replacement, considering your unit's age and the extent of the damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacement if your gas water heater is old, needs costly repairs, or is inefficient; CG Plumbing Solutions can help you compare options.
